# Deepriton

**Deepriton** is a 액체 (펌프로 연속 추출) ore. Each extraction yields **450** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/ko/formats/ore-fields/).

## 채굴

| Property | 값 |
|---|---|
| 채굴당 획득량 | 450 |
| 채굴 유형 | 액체 (펌프로 연속 추출) |
| 필요 효과 | 불필요 |
| 지질 탐사 문서 | definition 8699 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
